ABOUT US

Begin this next journey in your life with us at The Grand Canal Retirement Residence, the newest senior’s retirement residence in Welland!

 

Now is the time to live your life with purpose! Our wellness services and programs aim to promote not only an active way of life, but a lifestyle with your interests in mind.

 

Start your day with a cup of tea, or coffee, in the Bistro watching the sun come up and tip your hat to the day with a nightcap in the Pub! At The Grand Canal Retirement Residence, you have the freedom to spend your days however you’d like.

Who We Are

We are a team of friendly, knowledgeable, and experienced professionals ready to welcome you (and your furry family member) to our community! As a leading senior living home in Welland, we want to help you enjoy every day to the fullest. Our commitment to you extends to your family and friends, all of whom are invited to your new home anytime!

Our Mission and Vision

We believe aging can, and should, be an adventure. Every day offers opportunities to enjoy your favourite hobbies and learn new skills. Our team members are here to support you with respect, compassion, and dignity.

Life at The Grand Canal Retirement Residence

Life at The Grand Canal can be as fabulous as you want it to be! Our beautifully designed suites are just the foundation for your new adventure. Immerse yourself in one of our fitness groups, social clubs, learning classes, or sign up as one of our volunteers for local community organizations.

 

Your life will be enriched by meeting new friends during one of our lifestyle programs, dining in our restaurant, or lounging at the pub or bistro. Invite your family and friends to join you! We also offer personal salon facilities as well as pet services for your furry friend(s).

 

Located along the Welland Recreational Waterway, you have access to various water activities, walking trails, nature parks, shops, and entertainment facilities. Due to its connection with the local Welland Community Centre, residents have indoor access to the community centre’s year-round programs.

Our Experienced Team Members

 

Rely on any of our experienced team members to help you feel welcomed in your new home. Our friendly professional team have the expertise, knowledge, and compassion to ensure all of your needs are met.

 

The Grand Canal Retirement Residence is certified and regulated by the not-for-profit corporation Retirement Homes Regulatory Authority (RHRA) and are members of the Ontario Retirement Communities Association (ORCA). This independent group was established under the Retirement Homes Act 2010 by the Ontario provincial government.

Why Choose The Grand Canal Retirement Residence in Welland?

Choose the life you are meant to have by fulfilling your purpose at The Grand Canal Retirement Residence in Welland! Our lifestyle programs and activities are designed with you in mind. The courteous team members at The Grand Canal are here for YOU!
